The Hollywood Reporter has published a new, wide-ranging report exploring the making of Ted Lasso season 4, including positive news about how the new season compares to the previous ones.

Ted Lasso season 4 is on the way and reportedly "much stronger" than season 3

The wait for the return of Ted Lasso is almost over, with just two weeks to go.

Ted Lasso season 4 will debut with one episode on Wednesday, August 5, and then one new episode per week through October 7.

The Hollywood Reporter published an in-depth behind-the-scenes feature today breaking down how the new season came together.

If you're a Ted Lasso fan, the article is packed with great stuff and well worth a read. It covers a number of topics, including:

  • Jason Sudeikis' reluctance to continue the show, and what eventually changed his mind
  • A potential Ted Lasso spinoff that may or may not actually happen
  • The production struggles of season 3
  • Sudeikis and Bill Lawrence going their separate ways
  • The role of newcomer Jack Burditt in season 4
  • And much more

Season 4 reviews haven't dropped yet, but the report does drop some positive news about the quality of the new season. Lacey Rose wrote:

Of course, that comes with a major caveat — it's based on the word of insiders connected with the show. However, as someone who thought season 3 was a mixed bag, the report leaves me cautiously optimistic about the new season.

How excited are you for Ted Lasso season 4? Let us know in the comments.
